hypothesis: The live action adapter fails because it composes canonical rotations around both the wrong parent-axis frame and a captured standing neutral that is not the observation bind. Starting at the first policy target write, component-space axis plus bind neutral will make the action and observation adapters exact inverses and may improve the locked standing verdict.
design: 2x2 factorial beginning only after the first policy input and output are captured
validity_gates: All arms use the same clean behavior commit and reused binary.
First-policy input snapshot is byte-identical across all four arms.
First policy.jsonl raw and conditioned output vectors are byte-identical across all four arms.
All traces contain 21 complete controls and 19 decisive one-to-one controls.
Target readback match ratio remains 1.0 in every arm.

semantic_predictions.A_world_captured: Identity residual equals captured-neutral-versus-bind offset; actual and probe errors contain additional world-axis excess.
semantic_predictions.B_component_captured: Identity residual is unchanged from A; actual and probe errors equal that residual within 0.001 degrees.
semantic_predictions.C_world_bind: Identity residual is at most 0.001 degrees; non-identity actual/probe errors retain world-axis excess.
semantic_predictions.D_component_bind: Identity, actual, and all decisive axis-probe errors are at most 0.001 degrees.

physical_judge: Unchanged scripts/evaluate_standing_plant.py and standing-plant-ladder.v2 thresholds. Report all metrics and failed criteria without promotion or threshold changes.
support: Validity gates pass, all four semantic patterns match, and D strictly improves the physical verdict or all preregistered stability metrics relative to A.
falsification: Validity gates pass but D does not satisfy the exact inverse semantic prediction, or D satisfies it while physical standing does not improve; the latter falsifies adapter mismatch as sufficient cause of standing failure.
next_if_semantically_exact_but_physicall: Separate transition shock from steady adapter semantics using deterministic active-state checkpoint/reset or a gradual neutral/axis handoff with unchanged terminal mapping, then test the same endpoint without an impulse confound.
